MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Access to Japanese Scientific and Technical Information in Japan
1. Reference is Memorandum for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, AG 000.91 (26 Jul 48) ESS/ST, SCAPIN 1925/2, 14 April 1949, subject as above.
2. The provisions of reference memorandum are extended to 31 March 1950.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General

MEMO FOR RECORD: (SCAPIN - 1925/3)
WFM JWO'B HCK/ECA/CGK/ms
19 January 1950
1. References are:
a. Radio from DA to SCAP W 85022, 2 Jul 48, which established policy allowing access to Japanese scientific and technical information in Japan (FEC 280/9) to Far Eastern Commission countries, this policy to extend from 1 Jul 48 through 31 Mar 49. (Tab A)
b. Radio from DA to SCAP W 82089, 1 Jan 49, which extended this same policy to non-FEC countries who were at war with Japan subsequent to 7 Dec 41, provided such extension would not prejudice the privileges of FEC countries. (Tab B)
c. Radio from DA to SCAP W 38060, 7 May 49, which extended this policy from 31 Mar 49 through 31 Dec 49. (Tab C)
d. Radio from SCAP to DA C 54126, 23 Dec 49, which requested information as to the policy on continuation of FEC Directive 280/9 which was scheduled to terminate on 31 Dec 49. (Tab D)
e. Radio from DA to SCAP W 97978, 30 Dec 49, which states in part, ''SCAP can extend time limit if so desired. However, it is believed that extension should not exceed time necessary to terminate investigations in progress. Assume this can be accomplished by 31 Mar 50." (Tab E)
f. Memorandum for the Japanese Government from SCAP, AG 000.91 (26 Jul 48) ESS/ST, SCAPIN 1925/2, 14 Apr 49, subj: Access to Japanese Scientific and Technical Information in Japan. (Tab F)
2. Reference is directed the Japanese Government that the period of access to Japanese scientific and technical information in Japan was extended to 31 Dec 49.
3. This action extends the period of subject policies to 31 Mar 50 for technical representatives recently cleared to enter Japan with approval limited to 31 Dec 49 but with the requirement that they complete their investigations prior to 31 Mar 50. Applications for technical representatives submitted in connection with FEC 280/9 subsequent to 31 Dec 49 will not be approved except in very special circumstances and then only if investigations can be completed before 31 Mar 50.
4. This is an administrative matter.
5. Concurrences: None required. (Original implementing instructions and extensions to 31 Mar 50 were approved by the Chief of Staff after appropriate coordination: Vide ESS/ST check sheet to C/S dated 6 Jan 50.)
C. G. Keller 26-8064
J. W. O'B.
